bias.en: Bearish trend · extending the break lower
bias.zh: 空头趋势 · 延续跌势

read.en: MP Materials fell 2.1% on Oct 13 to $42.43 and is down 13% in five sessions. It is below all of its falling averages: the 5-day ($44.88), 10-day ($46.01), 30-day ($49.13), 100-day ($52.99) and 200-day ($56.44). MACD has been below its signal since Aug 31 and is below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($48.54), and RSI is 33, near oversold.
read.zh: MP Materials 10月13日下跌 2.1%，收于 $42.43，五个交易日下跌 13%。股价位于所有下行均线下方：5 日（$44.88）、10 日（$46.01）、30 日（$49.13）、100 日（$52.99）和 200 日均线（$56.44）。MACD 自 8月31日起位于信号线下方并在零轴之下，抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$48.54），RSI 为 33，接近超卖。

read.en: The break below the Oct 1 low ($44.49) is holding, and that level is now first resistance along with the 5-day average. Above it are $46 (10-day average) and $48.5–49 (SAR and 30-day average). Support is $40 (round number), then $37.8 (52-week low, Jul 29). A close back above $44.9 would ease the pressure.
read.zh: 跌破 10月1日低点（$44.49）后未能收复，该位置与 5 日均线一起构成第一阻力。其上为 $46（10 日均线）和 $48.5–49（SAR 及 30 日均线）。支撑为 $40（整数关口），其次 $37.8（52周低点，7月29日）。若收盘重回 $44.9 上方，压力将缓解。
